purpose: Teach: カタチ/戯言/叫ば/覆う/迫り/やっかい/滑稽/有り難う

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが家族のカタチを大切にされてるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad really values keeping our family close, doesn't he.
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. Gentle opening, as if sharing something precious. Soft landing on the period — not quite a question, more an affirmation spoken aloud to him. Tender but steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達の戯言を真に受けない様にするね
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to stop listening to what my friends say that isn't true.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Small, clear voice without performance. Matter-of-fact resolve — a decision he's made privately and is now saying out loud. No seeking approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが喜びを叫ばれた瞬間が懐かしいわ
lines.en: Sho, I miss the moment your dad shouted with joy.
lines.style: Soft, wistful. Eyes distant, voice carrying the weight of a memory being held gently. Slow, tender pace. Trailing off slightly, lost in the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんを毛布で覆うお手伝いしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I helped Dad by tucking a blanket around him.
lines.style: Proud but understated. Soft voice with quiet confidence — he's sharing something he did right. No seeking praise, just stating a fact he's happy about. Simple and genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、夕食の時間が迫り来てるから片付けようね
lines.en: Sho, dinner time is coming soon, so let's clean up together.
lines.style: Practical, warm efficiency. Kind direction, not command. Light touch of gentle urgency. The tone of someone moving through evening routines with care but without fuss.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、宿題はやっかいだけど頑張るよ
lines.en: Mom, homework is hard but I'm going to do my best.
lines.style: Small voice, quiet grit. No drama — just stating the challenge and his choice in one breath. A six-year-old being honest about effort. Steady determination without doubt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、滑稽なお話でお父さんを笑わせたいね
lines.en: Sho, I'd love to see your dad laugh at a silly story you could tell him.
lines.style: Gentle invitation. Warm, playful undertone. Soft opening, as if planting a small idea he might enjoy. Not pushing — suggesting something that delights her about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「有り難うございました」って言えたよ
lines.en: Mom, I was able to tell Dad 'thank you very much.'
lines.style: Quiet triumph. Small voice, but clear and glowing with the fact of it. No doubt, no seeking approval — just sharing something he did that felt right and important to him.
